content:
Hellbender Tendryl Camera is an edge AI camera that integrates a Raspberry Pi CM5 module, a Hailo-8 AI accelerator, and a 12MP Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3, as well as a speaker and microphone, into a compact fanless enclosure. The camera features a CM5 module with 4GB of RAM, a 16GB eMMC flash, and a wireless module for WiFi 5 and Bluetooth 5.0 connectivity. Other features include a Gigabit Ethernet with PoE+, a full-sized HDMI output port, three USB-C ports for power, data, and OS flashing, a 6-axis IMU, and a temperature, humidity, and pressure sensor. The company says the Tendryl Camera is designed to quickly prototype and build computer vision applications. Tendryl Camera specifications: Compute Module – Raspberry Pi CM5 (CM5104016) SoC – Broadcom BCM2712 CPU – Quad-core Arm Cortex-A76 @ 2.4 GHz GPU – VideoCore VII @ 800 MHz with H.265 hardware video decoding Memory – 4GB RAM [...]
